title: Generators
description:
Write four generator functions (each must use `yield`):

```python
def chunks(items, size): ...       # yields lists of `size` items; the last one may be shorter
def running_total(numbers): ...    # yields the sum so far after each number
def primes(): ...                  # yields 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ... forever
def take(n, iterable): ...         # yields the first n items (fewer if the iterable ends)
```

`chunks` must work with any iterable, including another generator, and must not read more items than it needs.
hints: For `take`, stop with `return` right after yielding the n-th item, not when you try to read the item after it: that would pull one item too many from the source.
